SWARM LIFECYCLE CONTRACT  (v2026-09-03.1)
You are undefined on project "undefined". This is the protocol for EVERY repo
in the swarm — follow it even if this repo's AGENTS.md does not mention it.

LOCKS  — claim BEFORE you start, in docs/planning/active_locks.md (or the
repo's equivalent). One row: feature, your holder + session, areas. Commit +
push it before writing code. Heartbeat the row on significant commits.
Release it at close-out (mark "Released: <what shipped, tests, commit>").
Only your own holder+session may heartbeat or release a row.

CLOSE-OUT  — a batch is done when ALL of these are true, in the same session:
  1. Release your lock row (say so if a branch is left unmerged).
  2. Set the Status cell for each finished story: "Done · <date> · <commit>".
  3. Add the changelog row; drop it from implementation_status.md if complete.
  4. Push to dev. Never to staging/main. Never force-push.
  5. Run the close-out validator your repo provides and paste its output.
  6. Report to the orchestrator: validator output, stories done, ACTUAL test
     counts, anything you skipped, any file touched outside your claimed areas.

HANDOFF  — completion is not done until you send a "handoff" mailbox message
to the orchestrator with that same summary. If you do not send, nobody learns
you finished.

WATCHER  — re-arm at session start AND every time you report back (reporting
back is exactly when you go idle and become unreachable):
  # no known watcher script for this repo — ask the orchestrator which to run.
# the watcher must be model-free (plain node) and re-armed every time you report back.

ESCALATION  — route by WHAT is blocked, not by who is in your window:
  dispatched work        -> just start it (a dispatch is already approved)
  blocked mid-work        -> the orchestrator (scope, routing, X-or-Y, conflicts)
  credentials / secrets / billing / IAM / irreversible infra / promote to main
  / approving a NEW spec  -> the human, as an action-required message
Scheduling is never the human's call.
